answer: Control is one ripple per operator, signed at birth; every later head must hang from that same ripple or count as new and voiceless. Head k speaks only after k^2 tundra is locked against the ripple while heads 1..k−1 stay locked, and its first act must extend one serial wander log, forfeiting all tundra if two heads sign alike. Honest head: 1 tundra, one step. An operator faking n heads pays cubic tundra and n serial judged steps; splitting ripples resets to zero.
